SELECT COUNT(*) FROM board b
LEFT JOIN snack_board sb ON sb.board_id = b.board_id

SELECT b.board_id AS boardId, b.board_type_id AS boardTypeId, b.board_title AS title, SUBSTR(b.board_content, 1, 120) AS preview, b.board_create AS createdAt,
sb.eat_status AS eatStatus,
NULL AS eatStatus,
(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM board_like bl WHERE bl.board_id = b.board_id) AS likeCount, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM board_comment bc WHERE bc.board_id = b.board_id AND bc.delete_fl = 'N') AS commentCount,
CASE WHEN b.is_anonymous_yn = 'Y' THEN '익명1' ELSE m.nickname END AS writerName,
CASE WHEN b.is_anonymous_yn = 'Y' THEN ELSE NVL(m.profile_img, ) END AS writerProfileImg
FROM board b JOIN member m ON m.member_id = b.member_id
LEFT JOIN snack_board sb ON sb.board_id = b.board_id
ORDER BY likeCount DESC, b.board_id DESC
ORDER BY commentCount DESC, b.board_id DESC
ORDER BY b.board_id DESC
OFFSET #{offset} ROWS FETCH NEXT #{size} ROWS ONLY

SELECT b.board_id AS boardId, b.board_type_id AS boardTypeId, b.board_title AS title, b.board_content AS content, b.board_create AS createdAt, b.board_update AS updatedAt, b.board_view_count AS viewCount,
(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM board_like bl WHERE bl.board_id = b.board_id) AS likeCount, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM board_comment bc WHERE bc.board_id = b.board_id AND bc.delete_fl = 'N') AS commentCount,
CASE WHEN b.is_anonymous_yn = 'Y' THEN '익명1' ELSE m.nickname END AS writerName,
CASE WHEN b.is_anonymous_yn = 'Y' THEN ELSE NVL(m.profile_img, ) END AS writerProfileImg,
b.member_id AS writerMemberId
FROM board b JOIN member m ON m.member_id = b.member_id WHERE b.board_id = #{boardId} AND b.board_delete_fl = 'N'

mapper.select:
SELECT c.comment_id AS commentId, c.board_id AS boardId, c.parent_comment_id AS parentCommentId, c.member_id AS memberId, c.comment_content AS commentContent, c.is_anonymous_yn AS isAnonymousYn, c.delete_fl AS deleteFl, c.create_date AS createDate, c.update_date AS updateDate,
CASE WHEN c.is_anonymous_yn = 'Y' THEN (N'익명' || am.anon_no) ELSE m.nickname END AS writerName,
CASE WHEN c.is_anonymous_yn = 'Y' THEN ELSE NVL(m.profile_img, ) END AS writerProfileImg,
c.member_id AS writerMemberId
FROM board_comment c JOIN member m ON m.member_id = c.member_id LEFT JOIN board_anon_map am ON am.board_id = c.board_id AND am.member_id = c.member_id WHERE c.board_id = #{boardId} ORDER BY c.comment_id ASC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO board_comment( comment_id, board_id, parent_comment_id, member_id, comment_content, is_anonymous_yn, delete_fl, create_date, update_date ) VALUES( SEQ_COMMENT.NEXTVAL, #{boardId}, #{parentCommentId}, #{memberId}, #{commentContent}, #{isAnonymousYn}, 'N', SYSTIMESTAMP, NULL )
